headline: Colombian Court Extends Suspension of Aerial Coca Spraying Pilot
summary: A regional court in Colombia maintained the suspension of a pilot program for aerial herbicide spraying of coca crops in Putumayo for up to four months pending health and scientific reviews.
why: Crop control and anti-narcotics enforcement strategies directly influence rural economic stability and security policy in Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Judicial suspension halts government plans for aerial herbicide deployment in key agricultural zones.
